hook_text: South Africa is a puzzle with nine pieces. Can you put it together?
clip_script: A Grade 4 classroom in Pretoria. A giant floor puzzle of South Africa. The biggest piece: the Northern Cape. The smallest piece: Gauteng, where Pretoria is. Down in the south-west, the Western Cape. Along the east coast, the Eastern Cape and KwaZulu-Natal. In the middle, the Free State. Up north, North West, Limpopo and Mpumalanga. Nine provinces, each with its own capital city. Click, click, click: one country.
visual_style: Whiteboard puzzle of South Africa, nine pieces sliding in one at a time with their names and a star for each capital.
mood: Like finishing a puzzle together, satisfying and proud.
pacing: One province at a time from biggest to smallest, then the whole country clicking together.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find your own province on a map.
